A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same IDRBench research. All 32 pages of each version, including figures, tables, equations and Appendices A.1–A.9, support comparison without material reading gaps.

before.justification: v2 reports original benchmark results in Table 2, input-context ablations, human evaluations, a researcher user study and fine-tuning results.

after.justification: v4 retains original benchmark results in Table 2 and the appendix experiments, human evaluations and fine-tuning outcomes.

M1.justification: The paper-triplet framework, three task procedures, pairwise recommendation ranking, prompts, synthetic-data generation and LoRA fine-tuning procedure are unchanged. Removing supplementary comparisons does not revise these methods.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same six-discipline benchmark, IPI, both I3 subsets and I2R. The full-paper evaluation, researcher user study and synthetic-data fine-tuning coverage are also retained; the deleted diagnostics concern existing coverage.

E2.justification: Removing v2 Table 3 eliminates the additional I3 Subset 1 comparisons with llama-2-70B-chat and llama-3-70B-instruct. Its other three models remain evaluated in Table 2. The main table and appendix comparator sets are unchanged.

E3.justification: v4 removes the diagnostic protocol in v2 Section 3.4: embedding discipline and sub-discipline labels for 335 positive and 3,350 negative I3 pairs and comparing cosine similarities. Retained experiments preserve their prompting, input settings, metrics and recommendation tournament configuration.

E4.justification: The I3 discipline-similarity shortcut analysis and the alignment-oriented instruction-model comparison in v2 Table 3 are removed. The separate I2R similarity analysis survives in Appendix A.6, while the negative-sampling validation, full-paper ablation, error breakdowns and other appendix analyses remain.

E5.justification: Deleting Section 3.4 removes its descriptive dispersion reporting for positive and negative discipline similarities, including standard deviations of 0.118 and 0.091. Wilcoxon significance testing and human-rating standard errors remain unchanged, with no added run or seed information.

E6.justification: v4 omits the zero-shot/few-shot Macro-F1 results of 0.416/0.525 for llama-2-70B-chat and 0.645/0.836 for llama-3-70B-instruct, plus the discipline-similarity means of 0.267 and 0.299. Table 2 and the retained appendix results are unchanged; the three other rows of deleted Table 3 already appear in Table 2.

T1.justification: The task definitions, triplet notation, sparsity assumptions and reciprocal-rank equations are unchanged. The shortened creativity rationale is conceptual explanation, not a revised formal argument or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same benchmark novelty, progressive-task contributions, useful-ideation findings and claims about reasoning-related difficulties and post-training bias.

C2.justification: v4 removes the I3-specific conclusion that discipline proximity supplies no reliable shortcut and the explicit assertion that an ablation supports benefits from weaker alignment. Broader alignment explanations remain, including Appendix A.4. Section 7 also drops the qualification that full-paper inputs could provide a richer perspective.

D1.justification: The deleted similarity analysis takes its Sentence Transformers implementation description with it. Section 3.1 replaces the explicit promise to publish the collection pipeline with a reference to its appendix description. Existing code/data links, annotation instructions, model settings, fine-tuning hyperparameters and prompts remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive positioning against prior research are retained. PersonaFlow receives an updated title and year but has the same authors and arXiv identifier; this is a bibliographic update rather than a new related work.

P1.justification: v4 copyedits Sections 1–3, condenses existing explanations, and updates affiliations and acknowledgements. Section 3.4 and several short passages are deleted, but the overall narrative order and appendix prose remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: v2 Table 3 is removed and subsequent tables are renumbered. Figure 5 is enlarged and repositioned within page 9, with surrounding text and references reflowing. The remaining figures and tables retain their designs and reported content.

improvement.justification: Copyediting and the larger Figure 5 improve readability, and deleting the explicit alignment-ablation assertion tempers one interpretation. However, v4 removes the I3 shortcut diagnostic and unique model comparisons without replacement, drops the full-paper-input qualification, and retains broad post-training-bias claims. The resulting loss of supporting evidence and qualification modestly outweighs the presentation gains; the central benchmark and appendix evidence remain intact.
